question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**inventor**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage talks about John Biggins, who is credited with creating the first bank-issued credit card. The correct word should reflect his role in creating the 'Charge-It' program.
 
• "**Inventor**" is the best choice, as it refers to someone who creates or designs something new. In this case, John Biggins invented the 'Charge-It' program.
 
• Other options ("producer," "finder," "discoverer") do not fit the context. "Producer" refers to someone who makes something, but doesn't imply the creation of something entirely new. "Finder" suggests locating something, and "discoverer" usually refers to finding something that already exists.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Credit cards originated in the 1920s in the US, with European references dating back to 1890. John Biggins, inventor__ of the first bank-issued credit card, invented the 'Charge-It' programme in 1946, __for__ bank customers and local merchants. In 1950, Diners Club introduced their credit card in the US, __allowing__ customers to pay restaurant bills without cash. American Express __launched__ their first credit card in 1958, while the Bank of America introduced the Bank America Card (now Visa) in 1958. Visa, now known as the Visa International Service Association, is accepted in over 150 countries, making it one of the most __widely used__ credit cards available.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Producer" refers to someone who makes or manufactures something, but doesn't capture the creative aspect of invention in this context.
 
• "Finder" and "discoverer" are terms used for someone who uncovers something existing, which doesn't align with Biggins' role as the creator of the 'Charge-It' program.
